description.zh: 设置密钥的Key值。支持英文字母、数字、英文格式的下划线，必须以英文字母开头，6~20个字符
description.en: The Key value of the key. The value must be 6 to 20 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It must start with a letter.

description.zh: 密钥显示名称。支持汉字、英文字母、数字、英文格式的下划线，必须以英文字母或汉字开头，4~50个字符
description.en: The displayed name of the key. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). It must start with a letter.

description.zh: 设置密钥的secret值。支持英文字母、数字、英文格式的下划线、及特殊字符（@、#、!、*），必须以英文字母开头，6~30个字符
description.en: The Secret value of the key. The value must be 6 to 30 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and special characters. Special characters include underscores (\_), at signs (@), number signs (#), exclamation points (!), and asterisks (\*). The value must start with a letter.

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向开放API的用户
- 此功能效果仅是创建密钥策略，需要再调用绑定接口才能绑定到API上
- 此密钥绑定到API后，网关到您后端服务的请求会带有签名字符串，您的后端服务可以自定义是否验证该签名字符串
- 该接口调用的QPS限制为：单用户QPS不超过50
descriptions.en:
- This API is intended for API providers.

- The API operation only creates a key policy. You must call the binding operation to bind the key to an API.

- After the key is bound to the API, requests sent from API Gateway to the backend service contain signature strings. You can specify whether your backend service verifies these signature strings.

- The QPS limit on this operation is 50 per user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi create-signature --signature-name backendsignature --signature-key qwertyuiop --signature-secret asdfghjkl --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi CreateSignature --region cn-hangzhou --SignatureSecret asdfghjkl --SignatureName backendsignature --SignatureKey qwertyuiop
